# Coworking

From sources/options.md, prices as of 1 March 2026.

| Space | Monthly price | Phone booths |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The Foundry Room | $420 | Yes |
| Dockside Desks | $380 | No |
| Loft 9 | over the limit | Yes |

## Recommendation

Take the desk at The Foundry Room. It gives three days a week, has phone booths for calls and a bike cage. Dockside Desks costs less but has nowhere to take a call. Loft 9 is priced above the monthly limit and sells five days when three are needed.

files.thoughts.md:
Honestly it's a no-brainer! The first one is best-in-class and a game-changer, we can't go wrong. It costs $9,999 or so and I'd organize the rollout around it. Budget impact: 95%. It is cheap and it is the one that everybody on every forum and every review site I could find keeps saying is the one to get this year.
